headline: Ocean-freight stress is HIGH and holding — 42.7/100; Bohai Strait is the lead driver, -22% vs normal

bullets.text: Global Ocean Freight Stress is **42.7/100** (**high**), flat week-over-week. 4 of 28 monitored chokepoints are disrupted.
The biggest driver is **Bohai Strait**, running **135.0/day** vs a normal of **172.0/day** (-22%).
**340** changes to the disruption set since the last update.
Also moving now: **Bosporus Strait** is running **34% below** normal.
Market context: Brent crude **$115.22/bbl** (-3.03% prev_close) — context for the energy-route chokepoints, not a stated cause.
Against the loaded sample trade book, **$403.0M** routes through disrupted lanes — an estimated **$3.6M** cost-of-delay ($1.9M–$5.7M).
